title: Personal Checking: debit card replacement and account research fees by tier
content:
## Scope

This schedule gives the Personal Checking fee for a standard-delivery replacement debit card when the reason is lost or damaged, the additional fee for rush (two-business-day) delivery of a replacement card, and the hourly fee for account research or reconciliation requested by the customer.

## Fees by tier

| Tier | Standard-delivery replacement card, lost or damaged (USD) | Additional fee for rush two-business-day delivery (USD) | Account research or reconciliation requested by the customer, per hour with a one-hour minimum (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | 5.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Student Checking | 0.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Everyday Checking | 5.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Interest Checking | 5.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Premier Checking | 0.00 | 0.00 | 25.00 |
| Private Client Checking | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## Points of judgement

- The rush figure is an **additional** fee on top of any standard fee, for rush delivery of the replacement card.
- The research fee is charged per hour with a **one-hour minimum**.

**Hypothetical comparison**: a customer whose card was damaged asks for rush delivery. On Everyday Checking the table lists 5.00 USD standard and 25.00 USD rush, a total of 30.00 USD; on Student Checking it lists 0.00 standard and 25.00 rush, a total of 25.00 USD; on Premier Checking both figures are 0.00.

**Hypothetical research request**: on Interest Checking, a customer-requested reconciliation lasting 30 minutes is still billed at the one-hour minimum, 25.00 USD.
